notablePrerequisites: Master Biomancer has power 5 or greater.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Sage of Hours and causing it to enter the battlefield with five or more +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
